<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#050817">
<title>ITZ BIJOY 24 — Digital Universe</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#040713;--panel:#071326;--line:#253f68;--text:#f3f6ff;--muted:#a9b7d1;--blue:#39bfff;--violet:#9168ff;--pink:#e36cff;--mint:#62f5d0}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-3;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 14% 8%,#173c75 0,transparent 28%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 25%,#29134d 0,transparent 28%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,#092a47 0,transparent 36%),#040713}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(1px 1px at 12% 18%,#fff 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(2px 2px at 77% 32%,#8edaff 98%,transparent),radial-gradient(1px 1px at 42% 78%,#fff 98%,transparent);background-size:180px 170px,260px 230px,220px 210px;opacity:.42;animation:starDrift 42s linear infinite}
@keyframes starDrift{to{background-position:180px 170px,-260px 230px,220px -210px}}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}.wrap{width:min(1600px,100%);margin:auto;padding:10px}
.topbar{height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 22px;border:1px solid #35517a;border-radius:16px;background:#050b1bdc;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);position:sticky;top:8px;z-index:30;box-shadow:0 8px 35px #0008}
.brand{font-weight:950;letter-spacing:1.4px;font-size:20px}.brand b{color:var(--blue);text-shadow:0 0 18px #39bfff}.nav{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:12px;color:#c8d5ef}.nav a{transition:.25s}.nav a:hover{color:var(--mint);text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--mint)}.nav-cta,.btn{border:1px solid #6785c7;border-radius:30px;padding:10px 17px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#176bdb,#7544df);box-shadow:0 0 20px #315bff55;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;transition:.25s}.btn.secondary{background:#09152a;border-color:#48658f;box-shadow:none}.btn:hover,.nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 26px #6385ff99}
.menu{display:none;background:none;color:white;border:1px solid #526b95;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 10px}
.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr .95fr;gap:7px;margin-top:8px}
.panel{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#08162cF2,#050a19F5 75%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 35px #397bff0b,0 12px 35px #0008;min-width:0}
.panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 90% 5%,#6c4cff24,transparent 34%),linear-gradient(130deg,transparent 40%,#12345a1c)}
.panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;right:-100px;top:-130px;width:250px;height:250px;border:1px solid #6e91d52a;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 22px #5e8cff08,0 0 0 48px #5e8cff06}
.pad{padding:23px;position:relative;height:100%}.kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2.3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#82d8ff}.section-no{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#9caeff;margin-bottom:18px}.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}.heading{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,38px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-1px;margin:10px 0 13px}.gradient{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0%,#8ddcff 42%,#bd8aff 90%);color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.hero{min-height:385px;grid-column:span 1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#040a18 0%,#040a18e8 46%,#040a1850 100%),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center 24%/cover}
.hero .pad{padding:30px 25px;max-width:74%}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,65px);line-height:.94;margin:13px 0 8px;letter-spacing:-2.6px}.hero h2{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 14px;color:#d9e8ff}.hero .muted{max-width:330px}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}.available{font-size:10px;color:#b8f8e4;margin-top:17px}.available i{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;background:#42f0b5;border-radius:50%;margin-right:7px;box-shadow:0 0 12px #42f0b5}
.hero-portrait{position:absolute;right:3%;bottom:0;height:87%;width:43%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%;border-radius:48% 48% 12px 12px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 76%,transparent 100%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px #4b9cff66);animation:portraitRise 1.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
@keyframes portraitRise{from{transform:translateY(40px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.hero-orbit{position:absolute;right:3%;top:13%;width:42%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid #58cfff55;border-radius:50%;animation:orbitSpin 24s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}.hero-orbit:before,.hero-orbit:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:12%;border:1px solid #9d72ff70;border-radius:50%;transform:rotateX(65deg) rotate(35deg)}.hero-orbit:after{transform:rotateX(65deg) rotate(-35deg);border-color:#50d9ff65}@keyframes orbitSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.about{min-height:385px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;align-items:center;gap:12px}.photo-frame{height:285px;position:relative;border-radius:15px;padding:5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#62eaff,#8c4fff,#f17bff);box-shadow:0 0 28px #885cff55;animation:frameBreathe 4s ease-in-out infinite}.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 16%;border-radius:11px;display:block}.photo-frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;border:1px solid #a1aaff55;border-radius:19px;animation:framePulse 3s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes frameBreathe{50%{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(.7deg);box-shadow:0 0 38px #8c5cff99}}@keyframes framePulse{0%{transform:scale(.98);opacity:.8}100%{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:0}}
.about-copy h2{font-size:29px;margin:7px 0 12px}.about-copy h3{font-size:17px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 9px}.about-copy .muted{font-size:10px}.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}.info{background:#0a1b32;border:1px solid #28496c;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;font-size:9px;color:#d9e7ff}.info strong{display:block;color:#7ddfff;margin-bottom:3px}.signature{font-family:cursive;font-size:25px;color:#c9d7ff;margin-top:10px;transform:rotate(-7deg);display:inline-block}
.skills{min-height:385px}.skills-head{text-align:center}.skills-head .muted{font-size:10px}.skill-tabs{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:17px 0}.skill-tabs button{font-size:9px;color:#dce9ff;background:#0b1b31;border:1px solid #294364;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer}.skill-tabs button.active{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#5836e9,#1769ce);box-shadow:0 0 15px #664aff66}.skill-visual{height:155px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center}.globe{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 25%,#b4f4ff,#2872c9 38%,#25105c 78%);box-shadow:0 0 28px #46bfff, inset -12px -8px 20px #050a24;animation:globePulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}.globe:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(50% - 72px);top:calc(50% - 54px);width:144px;height:108px;border:1px solid #b18cff;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(-24deg);box-shadow:0 0 14px #7d61ff66}.ring{position:absolute;width:190px;height:105px;border:1px solid #5e9eff8a;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(24deg);animation:ringOrbit 8s linear infinite}.ring.r2{transform:rotate(-52deg);border-color:#bb7aff80;animation-direction:reverse}.node{position:absolute;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;background:#102a4a;border:1px solid #5a9bff;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#7be7ff;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 0 16px #327fff77;animation:nodeBob 3s ease-in-out infinite}.n1{top:8px;left:18%}.n2{top:15px;right:17%;animation-delay:.5s}.n3{bottom:8px;left:27%;animation-delay:1s}.n4{bottom:8px;right:26%;animation-delay:1.5s}
@keyframes globePulse{50%{transform:scale(1.06);filter:hue-rotate(18deg)}}@keyframes ringOrbit{to{rotate:360deg}}@keyframes nodeBob{50%{translate:0 -8px}}
.skill-list{display:grid;gap:8px}.skill-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:95px 1fr 30px;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:9px;color:#dbe7fa}.track{height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#152843;overflow:hidden}.fill{height:100%;width:var(--v);border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#28c5ff,#8e5cff);box-shadow:0 0 10px #46aaff;transform-origin:left;animation:barGrow 1.4s ease both}@keyframes barGrow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.projects{grid-column:span 1;min-height:420px}.projects-head{text-align:center}.filters{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:13px 0}.filters button{background:#0a1b31;border:1px solid #294361;color:#d9e8ff;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:9px;cursor:pointer}.filters button.active{background:#5637e8;border-color:#987aff}.project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.project-card{border:1px solid #2c4d73;background:#08182b;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s;transform-style:preserve-3d}.project-card:hover{transform:perspective(700px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-4deg) translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 12px 25px #287dff33}.project-art{height:88px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px;color:#d6eaff;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#5b64ff99,transparent 42%),linear-gradient(135deg,#0d2d55,#24134b 60%,#07182b);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.project-art:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-50%;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 42%,#ffffff22 50%,transparent 58%);transform:translateX(-65%);animation:artSweep 5s ease-in-out infinite}.project-card:nth-child(2n) .project-art{background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%,#ff8dcb77,transparent 40%),linear-gradient(135deg,#39204d,#102c4d)}.project-card:nth-child(3n) .project-art{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#29c4d677,transparent 40%),linear-gradient(135deg,#092f4b,#15133e)}@keyframes artSweep{50%,100%{transform:translateX(65%)}}.project-body{padding:9px}.project-body h3{font-size:11px;margin:0 0 4px}.project-body p{font-size:9px;color:#aebed7;line-height:1.45;margin:0}.project-tools{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:13px}.project-tools button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #36577f;background:#091a31;color:#dcecff;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s}.project-tools button:hover{border-color:#65caff;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 16px #399dff55;transform:translateY(-2px)}.project-tools button.primary{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#175bd0,#7043db);border-color:#766bff}.project-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}.project-search{flex:1;min-width:180px;background:#061326;border:1px solid #29476c;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;color:#fff;outline:none}.project-search:focus{border-color:#55c8ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #55c8ff20}.project-count{font-size:10px;color:#9fb9da;letter-spacing:.5px}.project-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;font-size:8px;color:#80dfff}
.services{grid-column:span 1;min-height:420px}.services-head{text-align:center}.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:20px}.service{min-height:104px;border:1px solid #2c4b72;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0c203b,#071426);border-radius:12px;padding:13px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.3s}.service:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#7b7cff;box-shadow:0 10px 22px #3a59ff26}.service:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-120%;top:0;width:80%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#7bdcff19,transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);animation:serviceScan 7s linear infinite}.service:nth-child(2n):after{animation-delay:2.5s}.service-icon{font-size:20px;color:#7edfff;text-shadow:0 0 14px #49aaff}.service h3{font-size:11px;margin:8px 0 4px}.service p{font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;color:#aebbd1;margin:0}@keyframes serviceScan{to{left:160%}}
.journey{grid-column:span 1;min-height:420px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#061326ef,#061326b8),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 75%,#1455a777,transparent 45%)}.journey-list{margin-top:24px;position:relative}.journey-list:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:13px;top:10px;bottom:14px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(#6b6bff,#35d9ff,#8d6cff);transform-origin:top;animation:pathDraw 2.5s ease both}.journey-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 48px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start;position:relative;margin-bottom:22px;opacity:0;animation:itemIn .7s ease forwards}.journey-item:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.25s}.journey-item:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.5s}.journey-item:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.75s}.journey-item:nth-child(5){animation-delay:1s}.dot{width:10px;height:10px;border:2px solid #a7a5ff;border-radius:50%;background:#07152b;box-shadow:0 0 12px #7d78ff;margin:5px 0 0 9px}.year{font-size:10px;color:#7ddcff;font-weight:800}.journey-item h3{font-size:11px;margin:0 0 4px}.journey-item p{font-size:9px;color:#aabbd5;margin:0;line-height:1.5}@keyframes pathDraw{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}@keyframes itemIn{to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(15px)}}
.contact{grid-column:span 2;min-height:265px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 45%,#2258a355,transparent 35%),linear-gradient(120deg,#061326,#08132b)}.contact-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:24px;align-items:center}.contact h2{font-size:29px;margin:9px 0}.contact-cards{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:17px}.contact-chip{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #31547d;border-radius:9px;background:#0a1d35;font-size:10px;color:#d7e8ff}.contact-form{display:grid;gap:9px}.contact-form input,.contact-form textarea{width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #2c4a70;background:#061225;color:#fff;outline:none;font-size:10px}.contact-form input:focus,.contact-form textarea:focus{border-color:#65caff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #46bfff19}.contact-form textarea{min-height:80px;resize:vertical}.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.contact-form button{cursor:pointer;justify-content:center}.form-note{font-size:9px;color:#9eb4d2;min-height:14px}
.footer{margin-top:8px;border:1px solid #253d62;border-radius:15px;background:#050b19;padding:20px 23px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.footer:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-10%;right:-10%;bottom:-44px;height:75px;border-top:2px solid #527eff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #35bfff);border-radius:50%;animation:wave 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.footer-col h4{font-size:10px;margin:0 0 10px}.footer-col p,.footer-col a{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#aebbd2;line-height:1.9}.footer-col a:hover{color:#71dcff}.socials{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}.socials a{width:25px;height:25px;border:1px solid #395c89;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#d8eaff;font-size:10px}.copyright{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid #223753;padding-top:12px;color:#7e91b0;font-size:9px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}@keyframes wave{to{transform:translateX(8%) translateY(-7px)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
#toTop{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid #6b9aff;border-radius:50%;background:#174db9;color:#fff;font-size:18px;box-shadow:0 0 20px #367bff77;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:20}#toTop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
@media(min-width:1200px){.hero{min-height:410px}.about,.skills{min-height:410px}.projects,.services,.journey{min-height:445px}.project-art{height:100px}}
@media(max-width:1050px){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero,.about,.skills,.projects,.services,.journey{grid-column:span 1}.contact{grid-column:span 2}.hero{min-height:390px}.about{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr}.skills{min-height:390px}.services,.projects,.journey{min-height:430px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.wrap{padding:6px}.topbar{height:56px;padding:0 13px}.menu{display:block}.nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:62px;left:0;right:0;padding:14px;background:#071126;border:1px solid #35517a;border-radius:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}.nav.open{display:flex}.nav-cta{padding:8px 11px;font-size:10px}.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero,.about,.skills,.projects,.services,.journey,.contact{grid-column:span 1}.hero{min-height:420px}.hero .pad{max-width:76%;padding:25px 18px}.hero h1{font-size:53px}.hero-portrait{width:46%;height:78%;right:-1%;object-position:50% 15%}.hero-orbit{width:45%;right:0;top:20%}.about{grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;min-height:350px}.photo-frame{height:245px}.about-copy h2{font-size:24px}.about-copy h3{font-size:14px}.about-copy .muted{font-size:9px}.info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.skills{min-height:390px}.skill-visual{height:145px}.projects,.services,.journey{min-height:auto}.project-art{height:100px}.service{min-height:105px}.journey{min-height:370px}.contact-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:15px}.contact{min-height:430px}.footer{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.copyright{display:block;line-height:2}}
@media(max-width:390px){.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.photo-frame{height:260px;width:72%;margin:auto}.about-copy{padding-top:8px}.info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero h1{font-size:46px}.project-grid{gap:7px}.project-body{padding:7px}.project-body h3{font-size:10px}.skill-line{grid-template-columns:85px 1fr 26px}.footer{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

<script>
const menu=document.getElementById('menu'),nav=document.getElementById('nav');
menu.addEventListener('click',()=>nav.classList.toggle('open'));
nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>nav.classList.remove('open')));
const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');observer.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
const topBtn=document.getElementById('toTop');window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>topBtn.classList.toggle('show',window.scrollY>450));topBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}));
const projectCards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.project-card')];let activeProjectFilter='all';const projectSearch=document.getElementById('projectSearch');const projectCount=document.getElementById('projectCount');function filterProjects(){const q=(projectSearch?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();let shown=0;projectCards.forEach(card=>{const matchesFilter=activeProjectFilter==='all'||card.dataset.type===activeProjectFilter;const matchesQuery=card.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(q);card.hidden=!(matchesFilter&&matchesQuery);if(!card.hidden)shown++});projectCount.textContent=`${shown} / ${projectCards.length} PROJECTS`}document.querySelectorAll('#projectFilters button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('#projectFilters button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');activeProjectFilter=btn.dataset.filter;filterProjects()}));projectSearch?.addEventListener('input',filterProjects);
const projectModal=document.getElementById('projectModal'),modalTitle=document.getElementById('modalTitle'),modalKicker=document.getElementById('modalKicker'),modalContent=document.getElementById('modalContent'),modalCopy=document.getElementById('modalCopy');let currentBrief='';function openProjectModal(card,mode){const title=card.querySelector('h3').textContent;const desc=card.querySelector('.project-body p').textContent;const type=card.dataset.type.toUpperCase();currentBrief=`${title}\nType: ${type}\nOverview: ${desc}\nPortfolio: ITZ BIJOY 24`;modalTitle.textContent=title;modalKicker.textContent=mode==='preview'?'INTERACTIVE CONCEPT PREVIEW':'PROJECT CASE STUDY';if(mode==='preview'){let symbol=card.querySelector('.project-art').textContent;modalContent.innerHTML=`<div class="preview-window"><div class="preview-top"><strong>ITZ BIJOY / ${title.toUpperCase()}</strong><span class="preview-pill">CONCEPT DEMO</span></div><h3 style="font-size:25px;margin:0 0 8px">${title}</h3><p>${desc}</p><div class="preview-cards"><div class="preview-card"><b>${symbol}</b>Creative direction</div><div class="preview-card"><b>✦</b>Clean interface</div><div class="preview-card"><b>↗</b>Responsive layout</div></div><div class="preview-note">This is an in-page concept preview, not a deployed live project.</div></div>`}else{modalContent.innerHTML=`<div class="case-grid"><div class="case-tile"><strong>01 / OVERVIEW</strong><p>${desc}</p></div><div class="case-tile"><strong>02 / PROJECT TYPE</strong><p>${type} · Personal portfolio experiment</p></div><div class="case-tile"><strong>03 / DESIGN FOCUS</strong><p>Clear hierarchy, responsive layout, accessible controls and a consistent visual language.</p></div><div class="case-tile"><strong>04 / NEXT ITERATION</strong><p>Add real project content, connect working demo links, test on devices and publish a case study with screenshots.</p></div></div>`}projectModal.classList.add('open');projectModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}function closeProjectModal(){projectModal.classList.remove('open');projectModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.body.style.overflow=''}document.querySelectorAll('.project-tools button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',async()=>{const card=btn.closest('.project-card');const action=btn.dataset.action;if(action==='copy'){const title=card.querySelector('h3').textContent;const desc=card.querySelector('.project-body p').textContent;const brief=`${title}\nType: ${card.dataset.type}\n${desc}\nCreated for ITZ BIJOY 24 portfolio`;try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(brief);btn.textContent='✓ Copied';setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent='⧉ Copy Brief',1500)}catch{openProjectModal(card,'case')}}else openProjectModal(card,action)}));projectModal.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',closeProjectModal));document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeProjectModal()});modalCopy.addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentBrief);modalCopy.textContent='✓ Copied'}catch{modalCopy.textContent='Select text to copy'}setTimeout(()=>modalCopy.textContent='⧉ Copy Project Brief',1600)});filterProjects();
document.querySelectorAll('#skillTabs button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('#skillTabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');const g=btn.dataset.group;document.querySelectorAll('.skill-line').forEach(line=>line.hidden=g!=='all'&&line.dataset.group!==g)}));
document.getElementById('messageForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();const data=`Name: ${senderName.value}\nContact: ${senderContact.value}\nSubject: ${subject.value}\n\n${message.value}`;try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(data);formNote.textContent='Message copied! Paste it into your email or chat app.'}catch{formNote.textContent='Copy is unavailable in this browser. Please select and copy your message manually.'}});
</script></body></html>
